overview: Lewinnick Lodge is a restaurant with rooms on the clifftop at Pentire headland, just outside Newquay. Rooms range from doubles to oceanside superiors and a family suite, some with freestanding baths. The restaurant serves modern British food with an ocean-side terrace, and the South West Coast Path runs nearby.
